question: In the BatPaC scenario, how many times more cobalt would NMC 111 need than NMC 811 or NCA, and what pack energy and vehicle range does the scenario assume?
expect: ~2500 vs ~700 tons (p2.L93-96): 3.6 times; 260 miles, pack ~76.47 kWh, about 1,000,000 EVs (p2.L84-88)
rendered: According to the text, if NMC 111 is used, nearly 10 kilotons of cobalt would be needed to produce 1 million EVs. In contrast, NMC 811 and NCA would require approximately 700 tons of cobalt to achieve the same scenario. The scenario assumes a pack energy of 76.47 kWh and a vehicle range of 260 miles.
